text.content:
A defensible pocket off the switchbacks, quiet except for one occupant: a goblin sitting alone, stripped of whatever rank markings goblins here apparently wear, looking thoroughly sorry for itself.

GM Notes

Breather: Non-hostile. This goblin (call it Skree) will not fight and would very much like not to be found.

Subquest - The Demoted: Skree was bumped from the nuzzle hierarchy after Buttercup allegedly sneezed on it instead of nuzzling it - a fireable offense here - and deserted rather than face the Larders again. In exchange for safe passage or a promise not to turn it in, Skree will share real information: the general layout ahead, that Room 28 holds both "the King" and "the thing wearing the King," and a warning about the doorway wards (Rooms 8, 17-adjacent, 25, 28).
